saddle-search/pt-island.title: Pt heptamer island
saddle-search/pt-island.unit_source: The cost in the v2 scoring table is one displacement search. The archived force_calls is the mean over campaigns of each campaign's total: done.py and get_data_for_web_benchmark.m add every search until the campaign ends, and the benchmark website's Nf is the total number of force calls. force_calls / total_searches is the mean cost of one search, but the archive states no per-search cap. The PAR-2 that ranks the harness rows needs one, so the archived rows keep their own unit.
